result.title: Egocentric Action Recognition with Objects and Vision-Language Affordances
result.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Under review at IEEE FG 2027
result.summary: Action recognition, and more specifically egocentric action recognition, is a core task in computer vision, with applications such as monitoring the daily life activities of elderly people and task assistance. Recent methods rely on visual modalities such as RGB video or depth. However, in egocentric video, an action is largely defined by its objects, which these methods rarely model. We propose a method that combines a frozen SlowFast video expert with an attention-based object expert by late fusion. Each object is represented with its affordances, that is, what can be done with it, generated zero-shot by a vision-language model. Since datasets such as MECCANO annotate only the objects involved in each action, evaluating with these boxes tells the model which objects are active. We therefore train on annotated boxes and evaluate the method with detections from the official active-object detector, and with annotated boxes as an upper bound. Without affordances, our fusion reaches 68.4% Top-1 with annotated boxes but 49.0% with detections. About half of this drop comes from non-active detections. To remove them, the same vision-language model generates an interaction affordance that decides whether a hand is manipulating each detected object. On MECCANO, objects raise the Top-1 of the video expert from 44.9% to 49.0%, and the two affordances raise it to 49.9%, above SlowFast and object-aware RGB baselines. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向第一视角动作识别，将冻结的 SlowFast 视频专家与注意力物体专家晚融合，并用视觉语言模型零样本生成物体可供性与交互可供性，以判断检测框中的物体是否正被手部操作。
AI.relevance_reason: 不涉及 latent 推理状态，但「交互可供性作为门控」可提供视觉证据筛选、抑制非活跃检测的线索，可供核查其是否适用于 LVR 推理前的证据选择；冻结专家晚融合也提供模态组合参考。
